cd-bashaw-burned-1894.st: Bashaw was rebuilt: by 1896 H. M. Laursen ran a feed mill there two days a week (Washburn County Register, 10 Oct 1896, p. 1). The depot ground is unplaced. The 1915 Burnett County plat shows no railroad anywhere in T38N R14W, and sec. 14 holds only farms and a school, so the 'Omaha railroad stop' may refer to a stop some distance off. There is no 1937-41 air photo of this spot.
src: Washburn County Register, 10 Oct 1896, p. 1 (newspapers.com, PC thread sweep)
